name: RC-B10-0106/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament says Georgia's October 2024 election was rigged and that the government formed after it is not legitimate. It calls for new elections within a few months, for the release of protesters and journalists held in detention, and for sanctions on the governing party's founder Bidzina Ivanishvili and other officials. It also wants the European Union to stop supporting the Georgian authorities financially and to give that money to civil society and independent media instead.

- The Parliament asks for new Georgian elections and sanctions on named officials; it cannot impose either itself.
- It urges the European Union to cut budget support to Georgia's government and redirect 120 million euros to civil society.
- It recognises Salome Zourabichvili as president and asks the European Union to invite her to summits.
